items.checks: Identity; simplex versus sub-probability simplex; ordered multiplicities and types; integer exponent and dimension quantifiers; Newton identity coordinate relation.

Read rank, Morse, connected-fiber and boundary arguments. Detailed refutation of positive-eigenvalue to positive-quadratic-form step in Lemma 2.17, and traced use in Lemma 2.18. Did not independently reconstruct every singular-fiber or Morse-theoretic step.

Checked parametrizations, coordinate sums, endpoints and distinct tangent slopes of adjacent lower arcs; nonsemialgebraicity consequence depends on boundary description. Area formula not independently integrated.

Actual critical-point example satisfying both smoothness hypotheses exposes excessive quantifier in Lemma 2.28. Audited circular ending of Lemma 2.29, its missing attainable-sum-range argument and uses in Lemmas 2.31–2.32 and Theorem 2.27. No counterexample to the boundary theorem asserted.
Read Gale evenness and gluing, traced Lemma 3.5 to Lemma 2.17. Checked basic vertex/multiplicity interpretation. Full parity bookkeeping and global ball property not independently reproved.
Read limiting patches and verified diffuse-mass construction in Lemma 4.2. Did not independently prove all limiting face incidences.

Checked two-coordinate minimizer argument, triangular affine transformation, separating-hyperplane proof of hull equality, and hook-shaped copositivity test. Distinguished nonlinear power-sum change of coordinates for degree>=4. Not an exhaustive reproduction of cited historical results.

Trace definition permits products of traces of powers of individual matrices, not arbitrary mixed words. Exact p=1-2Y, M=300 disproves printed reduction equivalence globally; factors 2 and 6 restore coordinate correspondence. External Hatami–Norine and Diophantine theorems read as cited dependencies, not independently reproved.

Half-degree parameterization conditional on cited principle, rational simplex-weight density, continuity, multigroup common denominators, normalized versus ordinary trace quantifiers. No new established defect in this reduction; no independent implementation of quantifier elimination.
